borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>- D617/1 Location Plan September 22<br>- D617/4 Proposed Ground and First Floor Plan September 22<br>- D617/5 Proposed Second and Third Floor Plan September 22<br>- D617/9 Proposed Elevations September 22<br>- D617/10 Proposed Elevations September 22<br>- D617/12 Proposed Section September 22<br>- D617/13 Proposed Block Plan September 22</p><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

<p class="MsoNormal"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Contaminated Land <o:p></o:p></span></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Part of the ground floor has
been used as a vehicle repair workshop . This use may give rise to
contamination and the following condition is recommended :<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><ul style="margin-top:0cm" type="disc">
 <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:
     12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">No development shall
     commence until: <o:p></o:p></span></li>
</ul><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="a">
 <li class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:18.5pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo2"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">an
     investigation and risk assessment, in addition to any assessment provided
     with the planning application, has been completed in accordance with a
     scheme to<o:p></o:p></span></li>
</ol><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.5pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp;assess the nature and extent of any contamination on the site, whether or
not it originates on the site. The contents of the scheme are <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.5pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;subject
to the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. The investigation
and risk assessment must be undertaken by competent <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.5pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;persons
and a written report of the findings must be produced. The written report is
subject to the approval in writing of the Local Planning <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.5pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Authority.
The report of the findings must include: <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;i)
a survey of the extent, scale and nature of contamination; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ii)
an assessment of the potential risks to human health, property (existing or
proposed) including buildings, crops, livestock, pets, <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;woodland,
service lines and pipes, adjoining land, groundwaters and surface waters,
ecological systems, archaeological sites and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
ancient monuments; &nbsp;and <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;iii)
an appraisal of remedial options, and proposal of the preferred option(s).<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
This must be conducted in accordance with DEFRA and the Environment Agency’s
‘Model Procedures for the Management of Land <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Contamination,
CLR 11’; and <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="2" type="a">
 <li class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:18.5pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo2"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">a
     detailed remediation scheme, to bring the site to a condition suitable for
     the intended use by removing unacceptable risks to human health, buildings
     and other property and the natural and historical environment, has been
     prepared and submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in
     writing. The scheme must include all works to be undertaken, proposed
     remediation objectives and remediation criteria, timetable of works and
     site management procedures. The scheme must ensure that the site will not
     qualify as contaminated land under Part 2A of the Environmental Protection
     Act 1990 in relation to the intended use of the land after remediation.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
</ol><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:54.5pt"><span style="font-size:
12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="3" type="a">
 <li class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:18.5pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo2"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">The
     approved remediation scheme must be carried out in accordance with its
     terms prior to commencement of the development, other than that required
     to carry out remediation, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local
     Planning Authority. The Local Planning Authority must be given two weeks
     written notification of commencement of the remediation scheme works.
     Following completion of measures identified in the approved remediation
     scheme, a verification report that demonstrates the effectiveness of the
     remediation carried out must be produced and is subject to the approval in
     writing of the Local Planning Authority. The report shall include results
     of sampling and monitoring carried out to demonstrate that the site
     remediation criteria have been met.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
</ol><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="4" type="a">
 <li class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:18.5pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo2"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">In the
     event that contamination is found at any time when carrying out the
     approved development that was not previously identified it must be
     reported in writing immediately to the Local Planning Authority. An
     investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken in accordance with
     the requirements of (a), and where remediation is necessary a remediation
     scheme must be prepared in accordance with the requirements of (b), which
     is subject to the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></span></li>
</ol><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:54.5pt"><span style="font-size:
12.0pt">Following completion of measures identified in the approved remediation
scheme a verification report must be prepared, which is subject to the approval
in writing of the Local Planning Authority. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

















































</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Construction Phase <o:p></o:p></span></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The development is in close
proximity to existing residential property and the following condition is
recommended:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">&nbsp;</span></p><ul style="margin-top:0cm" type="disc">
 <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
     mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">No development shall commence, including any
     works of demolition, until a Construction Environmental Management Plan
     (CEMP)has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
     Authority.&nbsp; This Plan shall incorporate details of:</span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
     mso-ligatures:none;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB"><o:p></o:p></span></li>
</ul><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.0pt"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.0pt"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">a)&nbsp;the parking of site operatives’
vehicles;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.0pt"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">b)&nbsp;loading and unloading of plant
and materials;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.0pt"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">c)&nbsp;storage of plant and materials
used in constructing the development;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.0pt"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">d</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt;">) measures to control the emission of dust, dirt, and emissions to air
during construction;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:36.0pt"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt;">e)&nbsp;noise and vibration
control;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-right:19.3pt"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
f)&nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 12pt;">a waste management plan for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from
demolition and construction works.</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Demolition
and construction work and associated activities, other than internal works
inaudible outside the site boundary, are only to be carried out between the
hours of <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;08:00
and 18:00 Monday to Friday and 08:00 and 13:00 Saturday, with no work on
Sundays or public holidays without the prior written permission of the Local
Planning <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Authority.&nbsp;
<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Any works
which are associated with the generation of ground borne vibration are only to
be carried out between the hours of 08:00 and 18:00 Monday&nbsp;to Friday.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Demolition
and construction work and associated activities are to be carried out in
accordance with the recommendations contained within British Standard
5228:2009, <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;“Code
of practice for noise and vibration control on construction and open sites”,
Parts 1 and 2.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Once
approved the Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period for
the development.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>













































</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="xxmsonormal" style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;"><i><span style="font-size: 9px;">Noise Protection Scheme – External Noise Attenuation for Noise-Sensitive Development.</span></i><span style="font-weight: 700;"><span style="font-size: 11px;">&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-size: 11px;">The building envelope of the development to which the application refers shall be constructed so as to provide sound attenuation against externally generated noise sources to achieve the internal ambient noise levels detailed in&nbsp;</span><em style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-size: 11px;">External Noise Attenuation for Noise-Sensitive Development.</span></em><span style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-size: 11px;">&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-size: 11px;">The building envelope of the development to which the application refers shall be constructed so as to provide sound attenuation against externally generated noise sources to achieve the internal ambient noise levels no greater than:</span></p><p style="margin-left: 14.2pt;"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 11px;">a. 35 dB LAeq in living rooms and bedrooms (07:00 hours to 23:00 hours) with windows closed; and</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">​​​​​​​b. 30 dB LAeq in bedrooms (23:00 hours to 07:00 hours) with windows closed.</span></span></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 11px;">Additionally, where the internal noise levels will exceed 40 dB LAeq in living rooms and bedrooms (07:00 hours to 23:00 hours) or 35dB LAeq in bedrooms (23:00 hours to 07:00 hours) with windows open the scheme of acoustic protection shall incorporate a ventilator system which is commensurate with the Acoustic Ventilation and Overheating Residential Design Guide January 2020. The approved scheme shall be fully implemented before the first occupation of the residential unit to which it relates and shall be always maintained thereafter.</span></span><br></p><p><span style="font-size: 11pt;"></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 11px;">The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined in accordance with the latest British Standard 8233:2014 ‘Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings’.</span></p>

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">Notwithstanding the details submitted with the application, prior to above ground works, full details of the provision of 4 cycle parking bays shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This shall demonstrate that the cycle parking is in compliance with Policy T5 of the London Plan and meets the requirements of the London Cycling Design Standards (LCDS). Prior to occupation, the approved details shall be fully implemented. Thereafter, the cycle parking facilities shall be permanently retained.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14.6667px;">The proposed development shall follow Secured by design principles to the satisfaction of the local authority &amp; Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for its written approval prior to the first occupation of the approved development. All security measures applied to the approved development shall be permanently retained thereafter.</span></p>

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">Prior to commencement of the development, a CLP in line with the TfL guidelines shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council. The details shall include the numbers, size and routes of construction vehicles, provisions within/around the site to ensure that all vehicles associated with the construction works are properly managed to prevent any unwanted disruption to other highway users, and other matters relating to traffic management to be agreed with the licencing officers of the council. Approved details shall be implemented throughout the project period and any changes to the document must be reported back to the council’s planning and highways department.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:120%;text-autospace:none;vertical-align:
middle"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ligatures:none;
mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">Highway Works</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:120%;text-autospace:none;vertical-align:
middle"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ligatures:none;
mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">Prior to occupation of the development the
developer shall submit to the council a detailed highway design and enter into
a Highway consent licence to undertake highway improvements seeking to ensure a
detailed design to accord with the relevant road safety audit and cover new
Traffic Management Orders, kerb alignment and adjustment, footway resurfacing /
recon, to ensure parking and loading and service arrangements. The detailed
design works to be in accordance with the Design Manuel for Roads and Bridges and
Manual Contract for Highway Works specifications.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><u>Waste Management</u></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding the details submitted with the application, prior to above ground works, full details of waste management shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Prior to occupation, the approved details shall be fully implemented. Thereafter, the refuse storage shall be permanently retained.</p>
description: Construction of a first and second floor rear extension, the construction of a rear dormer extension including one roof light to the front and alterations including changes to the front elevation and staircase configuration to facilitate the creation of 2 residential flats (1 x 2 bed, 1 x 1 bed),  a self-contained office space and the retention of the existing shop
